steps.npc: I'm a little busy at the moment. What is it?

options.text: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?

steps.player: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
Wonderful? It's hot and dry all the time!

steps.npc: Not quite as hot as back home.
Oh, it's a town to the south of the pass, called Pollnivneach.

options.text: So, what do you do here?

steps.player: So, what do you do here?

steps.npc: If I had cloth, patterns and customers, I'd be a tailor. As it is, I'm a tailor with nothing to do.
The silk merchant won't even sell me any silks, because he doesn't trust me!

steps.player: Anything I can do to help?

steps.npc: No, no, it's all being dealt with.

options.text: I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
options.condition: If the player has asked any of the Al Kharid merchants about Ali Morrisane:

steps.player: I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...

steps.npc: Of course, he's the one who's going to obtain cloth and clothes patterns so I can set up shop here.
And in such a good location, too. Not out of the way like back home.
The customers will soon pour in!

steps.player: Maybe I should talk to him...

steps.npc: Why not? He's always happy to talk to potential business partners.

options.text: I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
options.condition: If the player has asked Ellis, the Shop assistant, or the Shop keeper (possibly other Al Kharid merchants as well) about Ali Morrisane:

steps.player: I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
One of the shopkeepers did say they were threatened by a man with large scissors...

steps.npc: Oh, them. Don't mind them. I think they're worried about what effect our shops will have.
For all they know, when we open our shops their wares will look cheap and shabby by comparison!
